framework.name: Slay-ILS-Designer
framework.title: Ontology-grounded RAG-enabled expert design framework for subsea inline structures
framework.description: Repository manifest for EDPR with explicit P-map/APF checks, EDES, EDAS, EDIKB, Knowloop feedback candidates, KEL knowledge evolution records, standard ILS layouts, validators, documents, examples, and runtime pipeline tools.

EDPR.name: Engineering Design Problem Representation
EDPR.role: Converts a natural-language design request into APF/problem-map JSON with objectives, constraints, candidate solution families, retrieval needs, and evidence requirements.

EDES.name: Engineering Design Equipment Schema
EDES.role: Stores individual equipment and OAM part knowledge under the FBS-OAM framework.

EDAS.name: Engineering Design Assembly Schema
EDAS.role: Stores assembly-building knowledge, valid topology rules, interface logic, standard layout anchors, and FBS-OAM assembly structure guidance.

EDIKB.name: Engineering Design Intelligence Knowledge Base
EDIKB.role: Stores behavior knowledge graph nodes, numeric evidence rows, guidance nodes, uncertainty notes, feature-interaction candidates, and ML study candidates.

Knowloop.name: Knowloop Feedback Candidate Knowledge Base
Knowloop.role: Captures one feedback candidate after every design query, including confirmations, improvements, corrections, future study candidates, and failure records. Official KB updates require human/expert review.

KEL.name: Knowledge Evolution Loop
KEL.role: Closed-loop governance plus deterministic v0.2 design gates: atomic/grouped feedback, lifecycle reconciliation, connector/layout rules, evidence gaps, expert review, implementation planning, and promotion.

runtime_sequence.name: read_manifest
runtime_sequence.action: Load framework_manifest.json first to discover schemas, prompts, knowledge sources, tools, examples, and Knowloop policy.

runtime_sequence.name: parse_problem_to_edpr
runtime_sequence.action: Use knowledge/edpr/EDPR_PARSER_PROMPT_RUNTIME.md. The parse must explicitly express APF and P-map before retrieval.

runtime_sequence.name: check_pmap_apf
runtime_sequence.action: Run tools/check_pmap_apf.py --strict to verify semantic P-map/APF completeness.

runtime_sequence.name: retrieve_context
runtime_sequence.action: Use tools/retrieve_context.py to load relevant EDES, EDAS, standard layouts, EDIKB graph, and EDIKB dataset context.

runtime_sequence.name: apply_kel_v0_2_design_gates
runtime_sequence.action: Normalize explicit connector/valve/topology intent. Block unsupported valve-protection or two-valve concepts; restrict vertical connectors to GD-B Z and ILT-Z-* anchors.

runtime_sequence.name: reason_over_design_candidates
runtime_sequence.action: Use EDAS for topology, EDES for component constraints, EDIKB graph for behavior, and EDIKB dataset for quantitative evidence.

runtime_sequence.name: handle_feature_interactions
runtime_sequence.action: Check EDIKB interaction nodes and numeric evidence. Do not assume simple superposition unless evidence supports it.

runtime_sequence.name: solve_and_explain
runtime_sequence.action: Rank options against EDPR objectives/constraints, cite evidence, and identify assumptions/future study needs.

runtime_sequence.name: emit_knowloop_candidate
runtime_sequence.action: Always run tools/generate_knowloop_candidate.py after the query, whether the outcome is successful, partial, or failed.

runtime_sequence.name: run_kel_governance
runtime_sequence.action: Optionally run tools/kel/run_kel_cycle.py after the design run. The default v0.2 flow captures v0.1 feedback, decomposes atomic issues, groups duplicates, and emits one graph request per group; review and promotion still require explicit human input.

validator_commands.kel_dry_run: python tools/kel/run_kel_cycle.py --label smoke --output-dir runs/kel/smoke --feedback-text "Plot must use the repository plotter." --dry-run

llm_bootstrap_instructions: Use repository paths exactly as listed.
For problem solving, do not rely on EDPR alone. EDPR tells the system what the problem is and what to retrieve.
Use EDES for individual component knowledge.
Use EDAS for assembly construction, interfaces, layout anchors, and valid structural composition.
Use EDIKB graph for semantic behavior rules, guidance, uncertainty, and feature-interaction candidates.
Use EDIKB dataset for quantitative comparison when numeric evidence is needed.
If no reliable dataset supports a proposed comparison, state that the behavior is a future ML/FEA study candidate.
After every design query, emit a Knowloop candidate JSON. Candidate knowledge is exploratory until human/expert review.
When human feedback contains several issues, use the KEL v0.2 atomic decomposition and grouping flow before generating graph change requests.
Apply tools/design_rules_v02.py intent and representation gates before emitting a layout or plot.
known_gaps_and_next_updates: Add vector-index retrieval as an enhancement after P-map/APF and Knowloop behavior are stable.
Connect tools/run_edpr_pipeline.py to an LLM API or manual LLM step for natural-language to EDPR conversion.
Extend tools/solve_problem.py with objective-specific scoring policies from EDPR rankingCriteria.
Add review-log tooling for promoting accepted Knowloop candidates into official EDPR/EDES/EDAS/EDIKB updates.
Complete the remaining phases in docs/PLOTTER_RESTRUCTURE_PLAN.md.
Consider replacing extensionless placeholder files such as knowledge/edpr/edpr files and tools/tools with README.md files.
